panel.fb_type_feature_hint: An idea to make TaskMate better
panel.fb_bug_title_placeholder: e.g. Child card shows 0 points after the midnight reset

panel.notif_section_custom_desc: Add your own timed reminders. For event-driven notifications, listen to the taskmate_* events on the Home Assistant bus.
panel.notif_section_matrix_desc: Toggle per recipient. The switch on the left disables the whole row globally. Cells marked — aren't valid for that recipient.
panel.notif_section_recipients_desc: Map each child and parent to a Home Assistant notify service. Leave blank to skip notifications for that person.

panel.notif_group_global_hint: Notifications sharing this name stack together on the phone instead of scattering through your other Home Assistant alerts. Applies to all notifications unless overridden per type below. Leave blank to turn grouping off.
panel.notif_test_sent: Test sent to {count} recipients + persistent notification
panel.notif_test_sent_one: Test sent to {count} recipient + persistent notification
panel.template_preview_hint: Review and customise each chore before creating. Expand to edit all fields, or remove with ✕.
panel.template_assign_all_hint: Tap a name to give every chore to that child. Leave empty for all children. You can change each chore below.

panel.toast_name_and_chore_required: Name and at least one chore required

notification.streak_at_risk.description: Fires when an active streak hasn't been extended yet today.
notification.streak_at_risk.name: Streak at risk
notification.streak_milestone.descriptio: Celebrates each new streak milestone a child reaches (off by default).
notification.streak_freeze_used.name: Streak freeze used

notification.streak_milestone.name: Streak milestone

panel.tp_anytime_hint: Always available, all day. Built-in and cannot be removed.

panel.tp_err_empty: Add at least one time period.
panel.settings_surprise_enabled_hint: Give each child a daily random chance of a surprise points bonus (rolled at 16:00).
panel.settings_surprise_params_hint: Daily chance per child, and the random points range awarded on a hit.
panel.reward_restock_hint: Periodically reset this reward's stock back to a set amount.
panel.chore_one_off_date_hint: The chore is on the board on this day only and switches off that night. Pick a day ahead to plan it in advance.
panel.chore_expires_hint: After this date the chore auto-disables. Leave blank for no expiry.
panel.bulk_pick_target: Pick who to reassign to first.
panel.bulk_delete_confirm: Delete {count} chores? This cannot be undone.
panel.settings_decay_enabled_hint: Periodically shrink each child's spendable balance to discourage hoarding.
panel.settings_decay_params_hint: How much of the balance to remove, and how often.
panel.gift_err_amount: Enter an amount of at least 1.
panel.settings_level_step_hint: Earned points needed to advance one level (XP = lifetime earned points).
notification.level_up.name: Level up
notification.level_up.description: Celebrates when a child reaches a new XP level (off by default).
panel.settings_spendcap_enabled_hint: Limit how many points each child can spend on rewards per period.
panel.settings_spendcap_params_hint: Max points spendable per period (0 = no limit).
panel.settings_interest_enabled_hint: Periodically pay each child interest on their spendable balance (rewards saving).
panel.settings_interest_params_hint: Interest rate applied to the balance, and how often.
panel.chore_due_time_hint: Completions at/before this time earn the early bonus; after it lose the late penalty.
panel.chore_require_photo_hint: Completions must be parent-approved; an evidence photo (if provided) shows in approvals.
panel.chore_open_ended_hint: The child writes what they did and suggests points. Always needs your approval — you set the real points.
panel.adjust_custom_title: Adjust {child}'s points by a custom amount
panel.backdate_hint: Pick the day, then tap the jobs that were done, just like on the sticker chart. They count for that day and week and are approved straight away. Hold a sticker to take it back.
panel.backdate_hint_list: For a job done on an earlier day that nobody ticked. It counts for that day and week, and it's approved straight away.
panel.backdate_none: No jobs were due for {name} that day.
notification.weekly_digest.name: Weekly digest
notification.weekly_digest.description: A Sunday-evening summary of each child's week (chores + points). Off by default.
panel.settings_celebration_notify_hint: Send a notification for big celebration moments (level-ups, streak milestones, perfect weeks). Off by default.
panel.settings_celebration_tier_hint: Only notify for moments at or above this size. Every celebration still fires a taskmate_celebration event for automations.
notification.celebration.name: Celebration
notification.celebration.description: Big celebration moments — level-ups, streak milestones and perfect weeks. Off by default.
panel.quest_need_chores: Create some chores first — a quest is a chain of existing chores.
panel.empty_quests_copy: Chain chores together into a quest. Finish every step to earn a bonus.
panel.quest_steps_hint: The child advances one step each time the chore at their current step is approved. Tap a chore below to add or remove it; use ▲▼ to reorder.
panel.quest_no_steps: No steps yet — tap a chore below to add the first step.
panel.quest_assigned_hint: Leave all unselected to make this quest available to every child.
panel.quest_repeatable_hint: When finished, progress resets so the child can run the quest again.
panel.quest_active_hint: Inactive quests don't track progress or award bonuses.
panel.settings_avatars_hint: {count} avatars in the catalogue. Children unlock avatars by reaching levels, points or streaks, then pick their own.
panel.avatar_dialog_hint: Define the avatars children can earn. Each row needs an mdi icon and an unlock requirement. Children can switch to any avatar they've unlocked.
panel.avatar_empty: No avatars yet — add one below.
panel.empty_challenges_copy: Set a daily or weekly target — complete N chores or earn N points — for a bonus that refreshes each period.
panel.challenge_target_hint: How many to reach within the period.
panel.settings_allow_negative_hint: Let penalties take a child's balance below zero instead of stopping at zero.
panel.chore_depends_hint: This chore stays hidden until the selected chores are approved for the child today.
panel.notif_quiet_hours_desc: No reminders are sent to this child during this window (do-not-disturb). Leave blank to disable.
notification.mandatory_reminder.name: Mandatory chore reminder
notification.mandatory_reminder.descript: Nudges the child when a mandatory chore is overdue, then reminds again after the escalation delay. Off by default.
notification.mandatory_parent_alert.name: Mandatory chore parent alert
notification.mandatory_parent_alert.desc: Alerts a parent when a mandatory chore is still incomplete after the parent escalation delay. Off by default.
notification.monthly_report.name: Monthly report
notification.monthly_report.description: A start-of-month recap of each child's previous month (chores, points, level, best streak). Off by default.
notification.season_champion.name: Season champion
notification.season_champion.description: Announces the monthly leaderboard winner at the start of each month. Off by default.
panel.ics_hint: Subscribe to upcoming chores from Google/Apple/Outlook calendar. The link contains a private token — share it carefully.
panel.ics_regenerated: New link generated — old subscriptions stopped
panel.allowance_hint: Convert points to a real-money allowance. Record payouts via the record_allowance_payout service or a dashboard button.
panel.allowance_rate_hint: How many points equal one unit of currency.
panel.family_goal_hint: A shared target across all children's combined points (e.g. everyone hits 500 → family movie night).
panel.family_goal_target_hint: Sum of all children's points needed to reach the goal.
notification.family_goal_reached.name: Family goal reached
notification.family_goal_reached.descrip: Celebrates when the family's combined points reach the shared goal. Off by default.
notification.birthday.name: Birthday
notification.birthday.description: Wishes the child a happy birthday in the morning (08:00 unless you set a time), with the day's points multiplier. Off by default.
notification.presence_arrival.name: Arrived home
notification.presence_arrival.descriptio: One "You're home — N chores left" nudge when a child with a presence entity gets home with chores still to do. Reminders held back while they were out land here. Off by default.
notification.wish_requested.name: New wish to approve
notification.wish_requested.description: Tells parents when a child adds a wish to their wishlist, so it can be approved and its target confirmed. Off by default.
notification.wish_pledged.name: Pledge to a wish
notification.wish_pledged.description: Tells a child when someone pledges points towards one of their wishes ("Grandma added 20 to your Lego set!"). Off by default.
panel.bounty_lock_hint: Time the claimer has to finish before it goes back on the board
panel.bounty_photo_hint: Child must attach a photo when marking done
panel.bounty_notify_hint: Sends the "New bounty" notification — switch it on and route the children under Notifications
panel.bounty_claimed_lock_note: Someone has claimed this bounty, so only its points and expiry can change now.
panel.bounty_expiry_past: Pick an expiry in the future.
panel.bounty_empty_copy: Post a one-off job with a fixed reward — the first child to claim it gets it.
panel.toast_bounty_posted: Bounty posted — it's on the children's boards now
panel.toast_bounty_released: Claim released — it's back on the board
notification.bounty_posted.name: New bounty
notification.bounty_posted.description: Tells the children a bounty is open to them when a parent posts one with "Notify eligible children" on.
notification.bounty_claim_lapsing.name: Bounty claim running out
notification.bounty_claim_lapsing.descri: Warns the child who claimed a bounty 15 minutes before their claim lapses and it goes back on the board.
panel.auction_page_sub: Children bid the fewest points they'd accept for a chore. Lowest bid wins.
panel.auction_empty_copy: Put an unpopular chore up for auction: the children bid the fewest points they'd do it for, and the lowest bid wins it.
panel.auction_refuse_open_ended: An open-ended chore is priced by the parent, so it can't be auctioned.
panel.auction_refuse_team: A teamwork chore is shared by a team, so it can't be auctioned.
panel.auction_refuse_timed: A timed chore is paid by the minute, so it can't be auctioned.
panel.auction_refuse_unassigned: Nobody can be given an unassigned chore, so it can't be auctioned.
panel.auction_which_hint: Only this occurrence is auctioned. The rest of the schedule is unchanged.
panel.auction_no_occurrences: No upcoming occurrence of this chore can be auctioned in the next 60 days.
panel.auction_no_chores: No chore can be auctioned yet. Teamwork, timed, open-ended and unassigned chores can't be.
panel.auction_max_hint: Children can bid anything from the minimum up to this. Lowest wins; ties go to the earliest bid.
panel.auction_min_hint: Off: any bid from 1 counts. On: stops a race to the bottom.
panel.auction_close_hint: Bidding must close before the day of the chore.
panel.auction_nobid_copy: The chore goes back to its normal assignment. You can re-open it with a higher max from the Closed list.
panel.auction_notify_hint: Sends "New auction" to the children who can bid, and a reminder an hour before it closes. Turn the auction notifications on under Notifications.
panel.auction_err_close: Pick a closing time before the day of the chore.
panel.auction_err_who: Pick at least one child who can bid.
panel.auction_err_min: The minimum bid can't be above the maximum.
panel.auction_close_confirm: Close bidding on "{chore}" now? The lowest bid wins.
panel.auction_cancel_confirm: Cancel the auction for "{chore}"? It goes back to its normal assignment, and anyone who bid is told.
panel.toast_auction_started: Auction started — it's on the children's cards now
panel.toast_auction_cancelled: Auction cancelled — back to normal assignment
panel.auction_delete_confirm: Delete the finished auction for "{chore}"? It's removed from the list. This cannot be undone.
notification.auction_opened.name: New auction
notification.auction_opened.description: Tells the children who can bid that a parent opened a chore auction with "Tell children it's open" on.
notification.auction_closing.name: Auction closing soon
notification.auction_closing.description: Reminds each child who can bid an hour before bidding closes (auctions opened with "Tell children it's open" on).
notification.auction_result.name: Auction result
notification.auction_result.description: Tells the children who could bid, and parents, who won an auction and at what price — or that nobody bid, or that it was cancelled.
panel.chore_weather_intro: Hide this chore while the weather is unsuitable. Useful for outdoor jobs — a rained-off chore doesn't count as a mandatory miss and won't break a streak.
panel.chore_weather_entity_hint: Leave empty to ignore the weather entirely.
panel.chore_weather_conditions_hint: Pick any conditions that should hide the chore.
panel.chore_weather_temp_min_hint: Hide below this. Leave empty for no limit.
panel.chore_weather_temp_max_hint: Hide above this. Leave empty for no limit.
panel.chore_weather_wind_max_hint: Hide above this. Leave empty for no limit.
panel.chore_weather_failopen_hint: Limits use whatever units your weather entity reports. If the entity is missing or unavailable, the chore stays visible.

panel.chore_tags_none: No tags in Home Assistant yet. Add them under Settings → Tags, or type a tag ID below.
panel.chore_tags_hint: The child is found from the HA user who scanned (their linked user). If nobody is linked, the tag only works when the chore is assigned to exactly one child. Approval, schedule and daily-limit rules still apply.
panel.chore_tags_blocked_hint: This chore needs a photo, a note or a timer, so a tag scan can't complete it.
panel.chore_tags_limit: A chore can have at most {max} tags.

panel.sched_note_hint: A reminder of why, shown beside the queued change.
panel.toast_sched_date_required: Pick a date for the change
panel.toast_sched_value_required: Enter a value for the change
panel.settings_roulette_enabled_hint: Lets a child spin for a random outstanding chore worth extra points.
panel.settings_unlock_allowlist_hint: Only these entities may be unlocked by a reward. Nothing is allowed until you add something here.
panel.settings_unlock_allowlist_add: Search for an entity to allow
panel.reward_unlock_intro: Turn something on when this reward is approved, and back off again after a set time.
panel.reward_unlock_minutes_hint: 0 = leave it on; you'll need to turn it off yourself.
panel.reward_unlock_no_allowlist: Add an entity to the unlock allowlist in Settings first.

panel.insights_no_data: No approved chores in this period yet.

panel.insights_friction_none: No active chores to look at.

notify.inspection_reminder: 🔍 {child_name}'s '{chore_name}' inspection closes in {minutes} minutes — pass or fail it before {until}.
notify.auction_no_bids: no bids for '{chore_name}', so it goes back to the normal rota.
notify.auction_called_off: the auction for '{chore_name}' was called off. It goes back to the normal rota.
notify.approve_in_panel_hint: Open the TaskMate panel to approve or reject.
notify.recap_ready_many: ✨ {count} new recaps are ready, {child_name}! Tap to watch them.
notify.recap_parent_one: ✨ New {period} recaps are ready for {names}. Tap to see them.
notify.recap_parent_many: ✨ New recaps are ready for {names}. Tap to see them.
panel.chore_reference_image_hint: A picture of the job done well. It's shown next to the child's photo when you approve.
panel.chore_estimated_minutes_hint: Roughly how long it takes. Cards add these up into “about 25 min left”. 0 = not set.
panel.chore_quantity_unit_hint: For “read 20 pages”: type the unit (pages, laps, minutes). The child says how many, and Points become points per unit. Leave empty for an ordinary chore.
panel.chore_quantity_max_hint: Caps one completion. 0 = no cap, and a parent approves each one.
panel.settings_auto_approve_hint: Chores still waiting this long approve themselves at the points promised. Open-ended chores and bounties always wait for you. 0 = off.
panel.settings_auto_approve_invalid: Auto-approve must be a whole number of hours from 0 to 168.
notify.mood_low: {emoji} {child_name} had a tough day today. Maybe check in?
notify.weekly_goal_reached: 🎯 {child_name} reached their weekly goal of {target} {points_name} — +{bonus} bonus!
notify.penalty_redeemed: 🤝 {child_name} made it right with '{chore_name}' and earned back {points} {points_name}.
notification.help_requested.name: Asked for help
notification.help_requested.description: A child tapped “I'm stuck” on a chore.
notification.mood_low.name: Tough day
notification.mood_low.description: A child picked the sad or cross face in the end-of-day check-in.
notification.weekly_goal_reached.name: Weekly goal reached
notification.weekly_goal_reached.descrip: A child reached the weekly points goal they set themselves.
notification.penalty_redeemed.name: Penalty earned back
notification.penalty_redeemed.descriptio: A child did the make-it-right chore and got points back.
notification.raffle_drawn.name: Raffle drawn
notification.raffle_drawn.description: A raffle closed and its winner was picked.
panel.today_sick_set: Sick day set — chores are hidden and the streak is safe.
panel.insights_moods_intro: Each child taps a face at the end of the day. A run of tough days is worth a chat.
panel.insights_moods_none: No moods logged yet. The check-in shows on the child card once the day's chores are done.
panel.weekly_goal_hint: Each child sets their own points target for the week on their card.
panel.weekly_goal_enabled: Let children set a weekly goal
panel.weekly_goal_bonus_hint: Paid once a week. 0 = no bonus.
panel.penalty_redeem_hint: After this penalty the child can do this chore to get points back. It's open to them even on days it isn't normally due.
panel.raffle_empty_copy: Put up a big prize. Children buy tickets with points, and one is drawn at the time you pick.
panel.raffle_prize_hint: What the winner gets, e.g. “Cinema trip”.
panel.raffle_cost_locked: Tickets have been bought, so the price is set.
panel.raffle_draw_at_hint: The winner is picked automatically at this time.
panel.raffle_who_hint: Leave empty to let every child take part.
panel.raffle_draw_at_invalid: Pick when the raffle is drawn.
panel.raffle_cancel_confirm: Call off “{name}”? Every ticket is refunded.
panel.pets_hint: Each child adopts a pet on the Pet card. It grows with every chore and wears accessories they unlock by levelling up.
notify.voice_chores_left_none: {child_name} has finished all their chores. Nice work!
notify.voice_reward_not_found: I couldn't find a reward called {reward_name}.
notify.voice_no_rewards: There are no rewards for {child_name} yet.
notify.voice_not_allowed: Sorry, you can't mark chores done for {child_name}.
notify.voice_chore_not_found: I couldn't find a chore called {chore_name} that's due today.
notify.voice_needs_card: {chore_name} needs a photo, a number or a few words, so do that one on your card.
notify.voice_done_pending: Done! {chore_name} is waiting for a grown-up to check it.
notification.pet_evolved.name: Pet grew up
notification.pet_evolved.description: A child's virtual pet reached its next stage.
notify.pet_news_stage: 🐣 {pet_name} just grew up! Have a look at {child_name}'s pet.
notify.pet_news_legendary: ✨ {pet_name} turned legendary! {child_name}'s pet is shining gold.
notify.pet_news_egg: 🥚 {pet_name} laid an egg! {child_name} can hatch a new pet.
panel.pet_xp_per_chore_hint: Every finished chore grows the pet this much.
panel.pet_points_count_hint: Each point earned adds 1 growth, so bigger jobs grow the pet faster. Spending points never shrinks it.
panel.pet_stages_hint: Each number must be higher than the one before. A pet never loses a stage it has reached.
panel.pet_never: Pets won't grow: growth per chore is 0 and points don't count.
panel.pet_after_hint: Turn on any mix. Numbers are total growth since adoption. Turning one off only hides it; nothing earned is lost.
panel.pet_home_enabled_hint: A new item for the pet's home (grass, a cushion, flowers, a tree, a pond…) every so often, up to 10.
panel.pet_legendary_enabled_hint: A gold, sparkling look: the big goal after fully grown.
panel.pet_eggs_enabled_hint: The child hatches the egg into a new pet; the old one joins the pet family.
panel.pet_egg_at_hint: Used when legendary is off; otherwise the egg comes with legendary.
panel.pet_family_max_hint: Pets per child, counting the current one. No more eggs once it's full.
panel.pet_levels_enabled_hint: A level badge on the card that keeps going up after fully grown.
panel.pet_settings_invalid: Pet stages must go up in order, and legendary and the egg must come after fully grown.
notify.reward_owed: 🎁 {child_name} is still waiting for '{reward_name}' — redeemed {days} days ago.
notification.reward_owed.name: Reward still owed
notification.reward_owed.description: Reminds parents that a redeemed reward has not been handed over yet. Only fires while reward fulfilment is on.
notification.personal_best.name: Personal best
notification.personal_best.description: A child beat one of their own records: longest streak, best day, best week or biggest award.
panel.fulfilment_hint: Approving a reward spends the points; this keeps it on an "owed" list until somebody hands it over. The child can tap "Got it!" on their card.
panel.fulfilment_enabled: Track rewards until they are handed over
panel.fulfilment_reminder_days_hint: Days before a push says a reward is still owed, repeated every that many days. 0 = never.
notify.boost_started: ⚡ Boost! {chores_text} pay ×{multiplier} for the next {minutes} minutes.
notification.boost_started.name: Boost started
notification.boost_started.description: Tells the children a boost covers that it has begun, how big it is and how long it lasts.
panel.boost_name_ph: Shown on the cards, e.g. Guests at six
panel.boost_notify_hint: Push to their phones, if the Boost started notification is on. Tablets wake either way.
panel.boost_preview_now: {what} pay ×{multiplier} for {who}, starting now, for {minutes} minutes (until {until}).
panel.boost_settings_hint: Time-boxed multipliers on chosen chores. Start one from Today, set recurring ones here, or use the taskmate.start_boost service in an automation.
panel.boost_stacking: On the weekend or a birthday
panel.boost_stacking_hint: Those days already pay a multiplier. Pick how a boost combines with it.
panel.boost_stacking_highest_hint: A ×2 boost on a ×2 Saturday pays ×2. The bigger one applies.
panel.boost_stacking_stack_hint: A ×2 boost on a ×2 Saturday pays ×4.
panel.boost_wake_screens: Wake these tablets when a boost starts
panel.boost_wake_screens_hint: Fully Kiosk Browser: screen on, screensaver off, browser to the front.
panel.boost_wake_screens_none: No Fully Kiosk Browser tablets found. Add the Fully Kiosk Browser integration to Home Assistant to wake one.
panel.boost_wake_devices_hint: Home Assistant Companion app on Android: sends command_screen_on.
panel.boost_test_wake_hint: Uses the saved choices. Save first after changing them.
panel.boost_rules_hint: Repeat on their own. Today shows each one before it starts.
panel.boost_rule_bad_times: The end time must be after the start time.
panel.appeal_note_uphold: Why it stands — the child will see this (optional)
panel.appeals_settings_hint: Children can ask for a second look at a rejected chore or reward, or a penalty, within 48 hours. You overturn or uphold it from Today.
notification.appeal_submitted.name: Appeal submitted
notification.appeal_submitted.descriptio: A child asked for a second look at a rejection or a penalty. Only fires while appeals are on.
notification.appeal_decided.name: Appeal decided
notification.appeal_decided.description: Tells the child whether their appeal was accepted or turned down.
panel.screen_time_hint: Rewards can buy minutes of screen time. While a child's devices are on, their balance counts down a minute at a time.
panel.screen_time_warn: Warn when this many minutes are left
panel.screen_time_stop_hint: Switches the child's devices off when the balance runs out, and keeps them off until it's topped up
panel.screen_time_no_devices: No devices yet — add the TV, console or tablet this child uses
panel.screen_time_add_device: Add a device: a switch, media player, input boolean, binary sensor, remote or light
panel.reward_screen_minutes_hint: Approving adds this many minutes to the child's screen-time balance. 0 for an ordinary reward.
panel.bin_day_hint: The evening before a collection, TaskMate reads your bin calendar and adds a chore per bin: “Put the Recycling out”.
panel.bin_day_calendars_hint: Any calendar with your collection days, e.g. from Waste Collection Schedule or your council's iCal feed
panel.bin_day_preview_none: No collections found in the next two weeks — check the calendar is saved and has events
panel.bin_day_put_out_time_hint: The chore appears at this time the evening before
panel.bin_day_mode_first_hint: Every chosen child sees it; the first to finish gets the points
panel.bin_day_mode_rotate_hint: One child per collection, round the chosen children in turn
panel.bin_day_bring_in_hint: A second chore on collection day: “Bring the Recycling in”
notify.screen_time_low: 📺 {child_name} has {minutes} minutes of screen time left.
notification.screen_time_low.name: Screen time running low
notification.screen_time_low.description: Tells the child (and parents) when their screen-time balance reaches the warning level.
notification.screen_time_out.name: Screen time ran out
notification.screen_time_out.description: Tells the child (and parents) when their screen-time balance reaches zero.
panel.trash_hint: Deleted chores, rewards and quests are kept for 7 days. Restoring brings back their history and completions too.
panel.trash_empty: Nothing deleted in the last 7 days.
panel.unsaved_leave_one: You changed {count} setting on this page.
panel.unsaved_leave_many: You changed {count} settings on this page.
panel.reward_reorder_hint: Drag or use the arrows. The rewards card shows them in this order.
panel.view_as_unavailable: The child card couldn't be loaded here.
panel.economy_intro: Points earned (chores and bonuses) against points spent on rewards, week by week.
panel.economy_chart_label: Points earned and spent per week
panel.economy_none: No points earned or spent in the last 8 weeks.
panel.economy_ok: Earning and spending are in step.
panel.economy_growth: Earning is up {pct}% on the 4 weeks before.
panel.economy_warn: In the last 4 weeks the children earned {earned} points but spent {spent}. Balances are piling up — consider raising {rewards}.
panel.economy_warn_no_rewards: In the last 4 weeks the children earned {earned} points but spent {spent}. Balances are piling up — consider raising your reward prices.
panel.economy_rule: Warns when the last 4 weeks' earning is at least {ratio}× the spending, with at least {min} points earned.
panel.seasonal_hint: Each season has a theme (the look of the child and kiosk cards) and an event pack (the content). Turn either on on its own. A pack installs itself when its season starts, as normal chores, rewards, quests and badges you can edit in their own tabs, and hides them again when it ends — nothing is deleted, and next year the same items come back.
panel.seasonal_summer_dates: 21 June – 31 August · suns instead of confetti
panel.seasonal_easter_dates: The week up to Easter Sunday
panel.seasonal_back_to_school_dates: Two weeks from the first school day
panel.season_assign_hint: None picked means every child. Grown-ups never get pack items.
panel.season_school_start_hint: Back to school runs for 14 days from this date. Set it again for each new school year.
panel.season_preview_note: Everything installs as normal chores, rewards, quests, challenges and badges. Change any of them in their own tabs once installed.
panel.season_remove_confirm: Remove the {season} pack? Its chores, rewards and quest go to Recently deleted for 7 days, and its challenge is removed. Children keep any badge they earned from it; a badge nobody has earned is removed. The pack is switched off.
panel.season_advent_doors: {count} doors · one small job a day
panel.season_hunt_eggs: A hidden egg to find each day
panel.child_celebration_hint: Plays on this child's cards when they tick a chore off. People who prefer reduced motion see none.
panel.screen_time_allowance_school_hint: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Added at the start of each day. 0 = none
panel.screen_time_allowance_weekend: Free minutes at weekends and holidays
panel.screen_time_allowance_weekend_hint: Saturday, Sunday, vacation periods and while the vacation calendar has an event on. 0 = none
panel.screen_time_allowance_unused_hint: Minutes bought with rewards always carry over
panel.screen_time_unused_expire: Expires at the end of the day
panel.screen_time_jar_enabled_hint: Children can save unused minutes in a jar that opens later
panel.screen_time_jar_opens_hint: Saved minutes join the balance at this time each week
panel.shopping_jobs_hint: Add “#tm fetch logs from the shed” to a to-do list (or say it to Assist) and it becomes a chore. When the chore is done, the item is ticked off the list.
panel.shopping_jobs_tag_hint: Only items that start with this become jobs
panel.shopping_jobs_mode_rotate_hint: One child per job, taking turns among the chosen children
notify.screen_time_jar_opened: 🫙 {child_name}'s screen-time jar is open: {minutes} minutes added.
notification.screen_time_jar_opened.name: Screen-time jar opened
notification.screen_time_jar_opened.desc: Tells the child (and parents) when the minutes saved in the weekend jar join the balance.
panel.reward_limit_hint: 0 means no limit. Waiting and approved claims count; a gift counts for the child who gets it.
panel.voucher_popup_blocked: Allow pop-ups for Home Assistant to print the voucher
panel.ratings_hint: Children give a reward 1–3 stars once they've had it.
panel.expiry_hint: Points not spent within a set time fade away, oldest first. The child's card warns them before they go.
panel.expiry_enabled_hint: Switching it on starts the clock today, so no points already saved expire early
panel.expiry_days_hint: Points saved into a reward's savings jar never expire
panel.gifting_hint: A child can spend their own points on a reward for a brother or sister. It goes through the usual approval, and the other child's card shows who it's from.
panel.gifting_enabled: Children can buy rewards for each other
notify.points_expiring: ⏳ {points} {points_name} expire on {date}. Spend them before they fade away!
notification.points_expiring.name: Points about to expire
notification.points_expiring.description: Tells the child when some of their points will expire soon. Only with points expiry switched on.
panel.toast_penalty_warning: Warning given — no points taken this time
panel.penalty_warn_first_hint: The first time in a period is only a warning on the child's card. The next time takes the points.
panel.penalty_no_eligible: No eligible children. Edit the penalty to set who it applies to.
panel.sibling_check_hint: An older child can check a younger one's chore instead of a grown-up, for a small bonus. Parents can still reject it or undo the approval.
panel.sibling_check_bonus_hint: Paid to the checker when they say “Looks done”
panel.sibling_check_need_two: Add at least two children to use sibling checks
panel.chore_reminders_hint: Children pick when they'd like a nudge about a chore, from their card. You set the earliest and latest times they can choose.
panel.chore_reminders_enabled_hint: Also switch on the “Reminder a child chose” notification and send it to each child's phone
panel.insights_calendar_intro: Chores done each day — darker green for busier days.
notify.chore_self_reminder: ⏰ Time for {chore_name}, {child_name} — you asked me to remind you!
notification.chore_self_reminder.name: Reminder a child chose
notification.chore_self_reminder.descrip: Sent to a child at the time they picked for a chore, on days it's due and not done yet. Only that child hears it.
panel.confirm_delete_suffix_restorable: You can bring it back from Settings → Recently deleted for 7 days.
panel.bulk_delete_confirm_restorable: Delete {count} chores? You can bring them back from Settings → Recently deleted for 7 days.
panel.bulk_delete_confirm_restorable_one: Delete {count} chore? You can bring it back from Settings → Recently deleted for 7 days.
panel.pet_shop_enabled_hint: Children spend points on cosmetics for their pet, at prices you set.
panel.pet_shop_approve_over: Purchases over this many points need a parent's OK
panel.pet_shop_carry_over: Bought items carry over to the next pet
panel.pet_shop_carry_over_hint: Off: a newly hatched pet starts with nothing bought.
panel.petshop_hint: Let children spend points on cosmetics for their pet. Fixed prices you set here.
panel.petshop_pending_hint: Approving takes the points now; declining takes nothing.
panel.petshop_empty: The shop is empty. Add an item or reset to the defaults.
panel.petshop_foot: Each item goes in one slot on the pet: hat, face, neck, held, back, body, colour or home. Hide an item to take it off sale; children who bought it keep it.
panel.petshop_delete_confirm: Remove {name} from the shop? Children who bought it stop wearing it.
panel.petshop_reset_confirm: Put the default catalogue back? Items you added are removed.
panel.petshop_name_builtin_hint: Leave blank to use the built-in name, shown in each family member's language.
panel.petshop_cost_hint: A fixed price in points, 1 or more.
panel.petshop_tint_hint: Colour items only: #ff8800, or rainbow (blank = rainbow).
panel.petshop_shown_hint: Hidden items can't be bought; children who own one keep it.
panel.petshop_emoji_required: Pick an emoji for the item.
panel.petshop_cost_invalid: The cost must be a whole number, 1 or more.
notify.pet_item_requested: 🛍️ {child_name} wants to buy {item_name} for {pet_name} ({cost} {points_name}). Approve it in TaskMate.
notification.pet_item_requested.name: Pet shop request
notification.pet_item_requested.descript: A child asked to buy a pet shop item that costs more than your approval limit.
planner.title: Week planner
planner.print_hint: Print this week's chart (the saved schedule)
planner.load_failed: Couldn't load whose turn it is: {error}
planner.rail_empty: Every chore is on this week.
planner.rail_hint: Drag a chore onto a day to schedule it. Striped cards repeat on their own rhythm, so moving one asks whether it's this week only or the whole series.
planner.hint_alt: Hold {key} to copy instead. Drop on a child's initial in a day's footer to give it to them.
planner.err_past: {day} has already passed, so {chore} can't move there on its own.
planner.err_no_land: {chore} wouldn't land on {day} after that change, so nothing was changed.
planner.err_copy_one_off: A one-off chore can only be moved, not copied.
planner.err_copy_series: A repeating chore can't be copied to an extra day. Move it instead.
planner.note_keep_assign: {chore} takes turns or waits to be picked up, so it keeps who it's assigned to. Change that in the chore editor.
planner.series_body: {chore} repeats ({rhythm}). Move just this one, or the whole series?
planner.series_body_rail: {chore} repeats ({rhythm}) and isn't on this week.
planner.series_once_desc: Moves the {from} one to {to}. After that it carries on as usual.
planner.series_once_past: Only a day from today onwards can be moved on its own.
planner.series_all_desc: The rhythm moves with it: it lands on {to} and repeats from there.
planner.series_start_desc: It starts again on {to} and repeats from there.
planner.save_err_wrong_schedule: Its schedule was changed somewhere else in the meantime.
planner.save_err_empty_days: A chore needs at least one day.
planner.save_err_rotation: A chore that takes turns keeps its rotation.
planner.hint_touch: Drop on a child's initial in a day's footer to give it to them. To copy instead, use ⋮ → Also on.
panel.tour_hint: A short walkthrough the first time a child opens their Child card or the Kiosk. It points at the real buttons, and each child sees it once.
panel.tour_enabled: Show a first-time tour on the Child card and Kiosk
panel.tour_auto_read_hint: Picture-only (pre-reader) cards only. Needs the read-aloud speaker below.
panel.tour_speaker_hint: Where the tour's speaker button talks (also the default for taskmate.read_aloud). Leave it empty to hide the speaker button.
panel.tour_note: Saved per child, so it follows them to any screen. Each browser also remembers it, so a shared kiosk won't replay it while it's offline.
panel.tour_reset_done: {name} will see the tour next time
panel.chore_sort_hint: Manual uses each child's own order from the reorder card. The other choices sort every child's chores automatically, new chores included.
panel.chore_sort_once_hint: Replaces every child's manual order with this sort. Fine-tune it afterwards with the reorder card.
panel.chore_sort_once_confirm: Replace every child's manual chore order with “{mode}”? This can't be undone.
panel.chore_sort_auto_note: The cards currently sort chores by “{mode}” (Settings → Chore order on cards). This order is kept and comes back when that is set to Manual.
panel.bulk_edit_intro: Switch on each setting you want to change. Only those change on every selected chore; everything else stays as it is.
panel.bulk_edit_children_hint: Replaces the children on every selected chore.
panel.bulk_edit_schedule_hint: One-off chores need their own date, so set those one at a time.
panel.bulk_edit_pick_one: Switch on at least one setting to change.
panel.bulk_edit_skipped: {count} updated. Not changed (the new settings don't fit them): {names}
